incidents.body: Between approximately 17:30 and 17:43 UTC, requests to add a new domain failed in the dashboard and through the public API (POST /domains). Verification of domains added during this window was also affected. The issue was identified and fixed, and domain creation has returned to normal. No domains were partially created: affected requests failed immediately, so retrying the domain creation will succeed. Email sending for existing domains was not affected.

incidents.body:
Between 20:15 and 20:16 UTC, a brief database disruption caused elevated error rates for approximately 45 seconds. During this window, requests to the Resend API, SMTP relay, and dashboard may have returned 5xx errors or timed out.

The issue resolved automatically at 20:16 UTC and all services have been operating normally since. Any request that failed during this window can be safely retried. Emails that had already been accepted before the disruption were not lost. They were delivered normally. Broadcasts were not affected.
incidents.title: Elevated error rates on email sending, API, and dashboard
